notes: AzScan 1.13.0 - all-new interface + much broader malware coverage. The whole app is rebuilt around the new design (dashboard, scan, quarantine, protection, updates and about - every page), with live threat counts, real scans and one-click quarantine restore. Detection is widened well beyond trojans and ransomware: cryptominers (XMRig / stratum pools), network worms (EternalBlue / MS17-010), kernel rootkits (DKOM process-unlinking), clipboard bankers that swap crypto-wallet addresses, IRC/DDoS bots, banking form-grabbers, credential dumpers (Mimikatz / LSASS), Meterpreter and RAT families (njRAT, Remcos) and fileless PowerShell loaders - each mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Keeps the smart anti-zip-bomb + anti-troll engine, owner fleet telemetry, RansomShield, the Anti-Trojan ATT&CK engine, IOC intelligence and the self-defense watchdog.
